SELECT d.school_id AS schoolId, COALESCE(d.school_name_snapshot, i.subscription_school_name_snapshot) AS schoolNameSnapshot, d.station_id AS stationId, d.station_name_snapshot AS stationNameSnapshot, i.subscription_window_id AS windowId, i.subscription_window_name_snapshot AS windowNameSnapshot, i.subscription_offer_id AS offerId, i.subscription_offer_sku_id AS offerSkuId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.spu_name AS productNameSnapshot, i.subscription_target_period AS targetPeriod, COALESCE(SUM(i.count), 0) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT i.subscription_student_id) AS studentCount
GROUP BY d.school_id, COALESCE(d.school_name_snapshot, i.subscription_school_name_snapshot), d.station_id, d.station_name_snapshot, i.subscription_window_id, i.subscription_window_name_snapshot, i.subscription_offer_id, i.subscription_offer_sku_id, i.sku_id, i.spu_name, i.subscription_target_period ORDER BY d.station_id ASC, i.subscription_offer_sku_id ASC, i.sku_id ASC

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.no AS orderNo, i.id AS orderItemId, i.delivery_id AS deliveryId, i.user_id AS userId, i.count AS count, d.school_id AS schoolId, COALESCE(d.school_name_snapshot, i.subscription_school_name_snapshot) AS schoolNameSnapshot, d.station_id AS stationId, d.station_name_snapshot AS stationNameSnapshot, i.subscription_window_id AS windowId, i.subscription_window_name_snapshot AS windowNameSnapshot, i.subscription_offer_id AS offerId, i.subscription_offer_sku_id AS offerSkuId, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.spu_name AS productNameSnapshot, i.subscription_target_period AS targetPeriod, i.subscription_student_id AS studentId, i.subscription_student_name_snapshot AS studentNameSnapshot, i.subscription_class_id AS classId, i.subscription_class_name_snapshot AS classNameSnapshot
ORDER BY o.id ASC, i.id ASC
